text: C-10 asserts its calibration axes compose with PAWL-007's existing two — a binary verdict and an attributable cause. Assumed PAWL-007's pair sits inside sample verdict, which is one half of C-10's pair, so they layer rather than collide. Nothing tests that and no samples exist to test it against; if they turn out to be the same distinction named twice, C-10 is redundant rather than wrong
